name: Kody Christiansen
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Kody Christiansen is a member of the West Hollywood Business Task Force and Chamber of Commerce, and a USC public administration master's student. He says overcoming homelessness and rebuilding his life in sobriety inspired his run. He proposes a WeHo Legacy Business Program supporting businesses operating 10 or more years, and a WeHo Civic Credit giving residents up to $150 for civic participation. He supports pausing the Flock Safety camera program while establishing strict oversight. He opposes new billboards and supports a local transit-oriented development alternative. He supports incentives for larger affordable housing units, a sliding-scale childcare pilot, and traffic calming measures. He created I Deserve ID to pay for identification cards and help people apply for housing and benefits.
